disposition_reason: Tables 2 and 3 print mean and range (and SD for sterilized milk by origin) of Cr, As, Cd and Pb (ug/kg) in 150 retail sterilized, pasteurized, fermented and modified milks from Henan.

study.origin: domestic (China) and imported from Australia, Germany, New Zealand, France, Belarus, Ireland and Austria (sterilized milk only)
